name: National Science Foundation research grants
description: The U.S. National Science Foundation supported research through grants to investigators and institutions.

impact.note: One agency extending existing project grants to civilian basic science; it served one country's researchers, and much later research across fields was funded by it.

date.basis: Date of the specified episode, not a global origin claim.

events.statement: The National Science Board approved 28 research grants on 1 February 1952.
events.scope: This documented community and episode; not a global first.

evidence.supports: The NSF timeline reports the initial grant approvals.

contributions.resource: Grants were approved for NSF award.

evidence.supports: The Board approved grants for NSF award.

date.basis: Date of the documented episode, not a universal origin.

events.statement: For the fiscal year ending 30 June 1952 the NSF reported 96 research grants at 59 institutions.
events.scope: Fiscal-year 1952 aggregate awards, not evidence of actual disbursement.

evidence.supports: Lists fiscal-year awards and explains application and payment policy.

date.basis: Annual report transmitted 1 November 1952, not necessarily the date of initial policy.

events.statement: The NSF annual report described scientist-initiated proposals, normally awarded to institutions for specified investigators, and planned advance payments.
events.scope: Guidance in the 1952 report; not proof of eligibility for every applicant or actual payments.

evidence.supports: Lists fiscal-year awards and explains application and payment policy.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest scoped episode established in these sources, not universal priority.

caveats: Prior public and private research funding existed. Approval does not prove payment or establish eligibility or success rates. The later annual report describes advance-payment policy and reported fiscal-year awards, but does not establish when any individual recipient was paid.

research.note: Initial source pass; independent review remains open. Independent review checked NSF’s 1 February 1952 approval and its count of 28; approvals are not treated as disbursements. Independent review read NSF annual report pp. 12–13 and 50–52: fiscal-year 96 awards at 59 institutions, and report-era application and planned advance-payment terms, distinct from February approval and actual payment.

measures.subject: National Science Board initial grant approvals
measures.conditions: Approved on 1 February 1952; not applications, grants disbursed or annual total.

measures.subject: NSF basic research grants
measures.conditions: Fiscal year ending 30 June 1952, not identical to February initial approvals or paid grants.
